invariants.title: Nobody is in it
invariants.rule: The first shot is the place alone: no figure, no hand, no silhouette.
invariants.why: The film opens on where it happens before who; a stray figure here reads as a third character.

invariants.title: The camera pushes in
invariants.rule: The camera moves down the aisle, steadily, with no tilt.
invariants.why: It is the only camera move that takes us somewhere; seed 11 tilted down as it pushed and read as a stumble.

flair.title: Rain
flair.note: heavy, on the roof and the skylights

title: the warehouse
beat: The empty warehouse at night, rain on the skylights, one lamp swaying. Nobody is here yet. The camera pushes down the aisle.
